entries.title: Psalms 27:1
segments:
. With a general strain of confidence, hope, and joy, especially in God's worship, in the midst of dangers, the Psalmist introduces prayer for divine help and guidance. 
 
    1. light--is a common figure for comfort. 
 
    strength--or, "stronghold"--affording security against all violence. The interrogations give greater vividness to the negation implied.

entries.title: Psalms 27:2
segments: 2. eat ... my flesh-- (

). The allusion to wild beasts illustrates their rapacity. 
 
    they stumbled--"they" is emphatic; not I, but they were destroyed.

entries.title: Psalms 27:3
segments:
3. In the greatest dangers. 
 
    in this--that is, then, in such extremity.

entries.title: Psalms 27:4
segments: 4, 5. The secret of his confidence is his delight in communion with God (
), beholding the harmony of His perfections, and seeking His favor in His temple or palace; a term applicable to the tabernacle (compare
). There he is safe (
). The figure is changed in the last clause, but the sentiment is the same.

entries.title: Psalms 27:6
segments: 6. head be lifted up--I shall be placed beyond the reach of my enemies. Hence he avows his purpose of rendering joyful thank offerings.

entries.title: Psalms 27:7
segments:
7. Still pressing need extorts prayer for help. 
 
    cry with my voice--denotes earnestness. Other things equal, Christians in earnest pray audibly, even in secret.

entries.title: Psalms 27:8
segments: 8. The meaning is clear, though the construction in a literal translation is obscure. The English Version supplies the implied clause. To seek God's face is to seek His favor (

entries.title: Psalms 27:13
segments:
13. The strong emotion is indicated by the incomplete sentence, for which the English Version supplies a proper clause; or, omitting that, and rendering, "yet I believed," &c., the contrast of his faith and his danger is expressed.

entries.title: Psalms 27:14
segments: 14. Wait, &c.--in confident expectation. The last clause is, literally, "and wait," &c., as if expecting new measures of help.
